title: ExamplePress Companion App Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for an ExamplePress companion plugin (an App). This schema encodes the rules enforced by ExamplePress\MU\Governance\AppValidator — both the active-plugin zero-trust gate and the generated-payload validator. Apps that fail validation are silently skipped by WordPress's plugin loader. Fields validated in PHP but not yet encoded here will be added over time; the schema and the validator should stay in lock-step.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion.

name.description: Human-readable app name. Required by AppValidator::validatePlugin (rule 2).

slug.description: URL-safe slug. Must match [a-z0-9-]+. Must equal the plugin directory name, the bootstrap filename ({slug}.php), and the Text Domain header. Required by AppValidator (rules 1, 2).

description.description: Short description displayed in the ExamplePress admin UI.

version.description: App version. Falls back to the plugin's Version header if omitted.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repo where the app's source lives. Required for the Codespaces and Propose Change workflows. A missing value produces a non-blocking admin notice but does not deactivate the app.

requires_kernel_api.description: Minimum kernel API version required (ExamplePress\MU\Infrastructure\Router::API_VERSION). Apps that target a newer API than the running kernel are deactivated at validation time.

permissions.description: App-declared permission strings. Filtered against examplepress_mu_banned_permissions; requesting a banned permission deactivates the app. Permissions are NOT automatically installed as WordPress capabilities — the app is responsible for its own role management.

supports_ai_iteration.description: Whether this app can be iterated on by the Agent. Validated as a boolean by AppValidator::validateGenerated.

routing.description: Route origin metadata. The PHP closures passed to examplepress_register_route_origin() remain the runtime source of truth; values here are read by the admin Route Visualizer and by AppDiscovery.

priority.description: Evaluation order. Lower wins. 1-5: core routes, 10: default, 20-50: add-ons, 90-99: catch-all/fallback.

routes.description: Declarative route metadata for the admin Route Visualizer. Display-only — does not affect dispatch.

desc.description: Short description of what this route handles.

troy.description: Troy Server integration metadata, written automatically when an app is connected to a Troy instance. Do not edit by hand.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo associated with this app on Troy.

updater.description: Optional per-app updater metadata. Most apps rely on Troy instead.

requires_kernel_api.description: Mirror of the top-level requires_kernel_api; either location is accepted.
